source_snapshot.test_name: PCIe Gen5 link up and NVIDIA device enumeration
source_snapshot.items: PCIe Gen5 link up and NVIDIA device enumeration
source_snapshot.procedure: Use the latest NVDiag version to run FCT.
source_snapshot.criteria: The log should show pass except for SKU check, and the SUT should remain workable.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: Run an unspecified NVIDIA qualification Gen5 linkup module and return a `pcie_gen5_linkup` log.

original_test_intent.purpose: Use the platform-supported NVIDIA factory/qualification diagnostic to verify required GPUs enumerate and their applicable host PCIe paths link at the approved Gen5 generation and width, then confirm the SUT remains usable.
original_test_intent.target: Every owner-expected NVIDIA GPU UUID/PCI BDF and its mapped upstream PCIe path on the exact server topology; non-PCIe primary paths or unsupported devices require explicit applicability handling.
original_test_intent.scope: Vendor FCT evidence plus independent pre/post enumeration and negotiated link generation/width for all expected GPUs; no generic inventory command may replace the required vendor diagnostic.
original_test_intent.operation: Stage the exact approved NVDiag build/profile, preserve topology and health baselines, run its documented FCT on an idle dedicated SUT, retain complete output, and correlate every result to GPU UUID/BDF and upstream path.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: One approved FCT run covering the complete expected GPU/path matrix; source timing is 10 attended and 20 machine minutes, with no module iteration count stated.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Every applicable expected GPU is enumerated at its approved PCIe generation/width, the diagnostic completes successfully under an exact exception policy, no new AER/XID/link/driver/platform error appears, and post-test usability is demonstrated.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: NVDiag build/hash/profile and documented module semantics, platform recipe, expected GPU UUID/BDF/upstream mapping, pre/post enumeration and link state, full raw FCT output/exit status, exact SKU exception decision, AER/XID/kernel/BMC deltas, and concrete usability/recovery checks.
ambiguities: `latest` does not identify a qualified NVDiag build compatible with the platform/driver/firmware.
The source does not name the FCT profile/module, side effects, command, target selection, expected GPU count/BDF topology, Gen5 width, or usability check.
`except for sku check` is an unbounded exception unless exact message/code, reason, and affected SKUs are approved.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly requires a qualified package/profile, topology, UUID/BDF mapping, Gen5 capability, approved SKU exception, dedicated SUT, side-effect review, complete logs and recovery. It incorporates DeepSeek's `pcie_gen5_linkup` label as though it were source-defined and does not clearly separate actual vendor FCT semantics from supplemental public nvidia-smi/lspci evidence.

applicable_history.decision: Vendor tools, package versions, target mapping and approval are supplyable readiness inputs; diagnostic side effects and recovery must be confirmed before execution.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: V2's classification is retained. V3 removes any assumption that DeepSeek's module/log name is authoritative, defines the required all-GPU UUID/BDF/upstream matrix, bounds the SKU-check exception, and separates safe actual-value collection from the still-unverified proprietary FCT execution.

available_now: The intended Gen5 link/enumeration objective, NVIDIA vendor FCT dependency, pass-log expectation and post-test usability requirement are explicit.

Read-only GPU enumeration, UUID/BDF mapping, endpoint/upstream link capabilities/status, driver/firmware identity, active jobs and existing AER/XID/kernel/BMC state can be collected before NVDiag is supplied.
missing_inputs: Exact server/GPU architecture and expected GPU UUID/BDF/upstream port matrix with required PCIe generation and width per path
Approved NVDiag build/hash/license/source, supported driver/firmware/OS, exact FCT profile/module/command/config, target-selection method, documented side effects and completion codes
Exact permitted SKU-check code/message/SKU/reason and whether it affects link or enumeration validity
Dedicated maintenance window, workload drain, telemetry/stop thresholds, concrete usability checks, OOB/recovery and approval
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The NVIDIA/platform qualification owner supplies the package/profile, compatibility matrix, topology expectations and SKU exception; the lab/service owner approves the dedicated window, side effects, limits and recovery.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Collect `nvidia-smi` GPU UUID/PCI bus IDs, driver/firmware state and current/max link generation/width where supported; collect `lspci -vv` for endpoints and upstream ports and map every expected path
Capture active GPU/host jobs, existing XID/AER/kernel/BMC/SEL evidence and OOB reachability without clearing logs or running diagnostics
prohibited_until_closed: Do not download or choose `latest`, invent a generic FCT command, assume `pcie_gen5_linkup` is the package's real module, run DCGM as a replacement, or execute unreviewed NVDiag on an active SUT
Do not accept any SKU-check failure generically, reduce scope to one GPU, infer Gen5 from enumeration alone, clear logs, or treat a `pass` substring without target/exit/profile context as completion
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: The owner supplies a signed build/profile manifest and expected path matrix; package documentation confirms targets, side effects, outputs and exception codes; all GPUs are mapped, workloads drained, OOB tested, and the exact stop/recovery/usability checks approved.

revision_candidate.test_name: NVIDIA GPU PCIe Gen5 Link and Enumeration Validation
revision_candidate.purpose: Run the qualified NVIDIA FCT for the exact platform and verify every expected GPU enumerates on its mapped path at the approved PCIe generation and width without new platform errors or loss of usability.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact NVIDIA GPU server topology, BIOS/BMC/GPU firmware, NVIDIA driver/OS and vendor-qualified NVDiag build/profile on a dedicated idle SUT with OOB recovery.
revision_candidate.target_scope: All expected GPU UUIDs and PCI BDFs and their mapped upstream ports. Apply Gen5 only to paths the platform recipe defines as PCIe Gen5; do not generalize to C2C or other primary interconnects.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Expected topology and Gen/width per path, approved NVDiag build/hash/license and compatibility, exact FCT profile/command/config/targets, side effects, bounded SKU exception, workload window, thresholds, usability checks, and recovery owner.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Collect a preserved enumeration/link/error baseline, run only the package-documented approved NVDiag FCT profile against the complete target matrix, capture full raw output and exit status, then independently re-collect UUID/BDF and endpoint/upstream link status plus AER/XID/kernel/BMC evidence. Do not substitute an invented command or another diagnostic suite.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Verified platform recipe and topology, complete expected GPU list, compatible driver/firmware/package, idle/dedicated SUT, reviewed side effects, approved exception policy and stop limits, preserved evidence, and working console/OOB recovery.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Build/hash/profile/config/command; expected and observed UUID/BDF/upstream matrix; pre/post max/current link generation/width; full per-target FCT result and exit status; exact SKU exception application; AER/XID/kernel/BMC deltas; process cleanup; and defined management/GPU workload usability checks.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The platform qualification recipe for expected GPUs and link generation/width plus the exact NVDiag build's documented result/exception semantics. Public DCGM or nvidia-smi documentation is supplemental, not the proprietary FCT acceptance definition.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: No unreviewed package/profile, active jobs, log clearing, generic exception suppression, reset/retrain action beyond the approved FCT, scope reduction, or automatic reset/reboot. Stop on target mismatch, link loss, GPU reset, AER/XID, management impact or undocumented state change.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Explicit approval is required for package/profile, side effects, workload drain, full target matrix, SKU exception, diagnostic window, limits and recovery.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Owners provide proprietary package semantics and exception policy; after approval, baseline, diagnostic launch, output correlation and post-checks are automatable. Unexpected vendor output and recovery remain engineering decisions.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop the diagnostic, preserve all output, verify no process remains, re-enumerate each GPU/path, use OOB on host/driver impact, and perform reset/reboot/rollback only under separate approved vendor recovery; quarantine unresolved link/AER/XID failures.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unknown build/profile or side effect, incomplete topology, active job, unapproved exception, endpoint/upstream link mismatch, missing GPU, link retrain/loss, GPU reset, AER/XID/kernel/BMC error, thermal/power issue, management loss, incomplete log, or failed usability/recovery check.

identified_defects: The source uses `latest NVDiag` instead of a reproducible qualified build.
The FCT command/profile and complete GPU/path expectations are absent.
DeepSeek invents a module/log label not present in the source, and a generic pass string cannot prove enumeration and Gen5 link scope.
reason_for_change: Prevent an agent from inventing proprietary tool semantics or accepting a log substring while preserving the vendor FCT intent and all-GPU Gen5/enumeration scope.

new_technical_evidence.title: NVIDIA System Management Interface Documentation
new_technical_evidence.supports: Stable GPU correlation should use UUID or PCI bus ID rather than enumeration index; NVIDIA reports PCIe link generation and width where applicable.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: This does not document the proprietary NVDiag FCT or replace its required package/profile.

new_technical_evidence.title: NVIDIA DCGM PCIe Plugin Documentation
new_technical_evidence.applicability: General NVIDIA PCIe diagnostic evidence, not a substitute for NVDiag
new_technical_evidence.supports: PCIe diagnostic interpretation compares negotiated generation/width with platform topology and monitors replay/AER and other GPU health errors.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: NVDiag FCT behavior, platform qualification thresholds and SKU exception remain unavailable.

removed_ambiguities: Makes every expected UUID/BDF/upstream path part of scope.
Treats the DeepSeek module name as unverified rather than a command.
Bounds SKU exceptions and separates supplemental read-only evidence from vendor FCT completion.
resolved_blockers: Missing vendor package, target matrix and approval remain provisionable readiness conditions; read-only topology/evidence collection can proceed now.
remaining_blockers: FCT cannot run until proprietary build/profile semantics, topology, Gen/width expectations, exception, side effects, approval and recovery are confirmed.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 keeps V2's correct capability and safety gates but removes an invented module-name assumption, enforces all-GPU path coverage and a bounded SKU exception, and prevents supplemental public tools from being misrepresented as completion of the required NVDiag FCT.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The validator preserved the qualified NVIDIA FCT, full UUID/BDF/upstream-path matrix, platform-defined link generation/width and independent post-test health evidence without inventing a diagnostic module.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: The source asks latest NVDiag FCT to validate PCIe Gen5 link and NVIDIA enumeration and allows an unspecified SKU-check exception.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 is largely correct but adopts DeepSeek's module/log label; V3 requires actual package documentation and complete UUID/BDF path evidence.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Collect safe inventory first; run no proprietary diagnostic until build/profile/side effects/targets/exception/recovery are approved; never accept a bare pass string.
